title: Halifax Ghost Tour Haunted Downtown and Harbour by Night
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the eerie side of Halifax on a captivating 90-minute walking tour that unveils the city’s ghostly legends and haunting history. As dusk descends, an expert local storyteller guides you through the streets, sharing chilling tales from the Titanic's morgue to a mysterious face in a church window. Visit historic sites like a 270-year-old cemetery and hear of the spirits said to linger in the shadows. This small-group tour offers an authentic experience steeped in local folklore and documented events, perfect for history buffs and thrill-seekers alike.
